# exemplified by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplifiedBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A document whose prose EXEMPLIFIES the voice — byte-perfect, carrying [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md) (SHACL: an undigested exemplar can drift silently) and [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](gmeow-hasAboutness.md) [`gmeow:aboutnessEnacts`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessEnacts.md) (it does not describe the voice, it performs it). NOT functional: several exemplifying documents coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) -> [`gmeow:Document`](../classes/gmeow-Document.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) from [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) to [`gmeow:Document`](../classes/gmeow-Document.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md), [`gmeow:Document`](../classes/gmeow-Document.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for Manifestation-rooted traversal down to its copies — enumerating the individual Items of one edition (a library's holdings of a title).
- Use to attach a document whose prose EXEMPLIFIES a style guide's voice — byte-perfect, enacting the voice rather than describing it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid an undigested exemplar (it can drift silently — SHACL requires [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md)) and avoid one that merely describes the voice; it must carry [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](gmeow-hasAboutness.md) [`gmeow:aboutnessEnacts`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessEnacts.md).
- Avoid asserting this directly when modelling from the copy up — prefer [`gmeow:exemplifies`](gmeow-exemplifies.md) and read this inverse — and avoid it for the embodied [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) (that is [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) from the [`gmeow:StyleGuide`](../classes/gmeow-StyleGuide.md) to each [`gmeow:Document`](../classes/gmeow-Document.md); ensure every exemplar carries a [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md) and [`gmeow:aboutnessEnacts`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessEnacts.md).
- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:exemplifies`](gmeow-exemplifies.md) from each [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) and read [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) by inversion; reach for it explicitly only in Manifestation-rooted projections.

### Examples

- ex:clinicalVoice [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) ex:sampleNote.
- ex:penguin2003 [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) ex:myCopy.
